question: Pātai
defaultDirections: Tīpakohia te whakautu e whakaaro ana koe e whakautu ana i te pātai. Ka oti ana, pēhia te {checkAnswer}. Ka whiwhi koe i te urupare e tohu ana i te tika o tō whakautu me te huarahi whakamua.
